products.short_description: A layered Outlook/OWA/Exchange client-connectivity troubleshooting toolkit — Autodiscover, MAPI/HTTP/EWS/ActiveSync, modern auth/CA, profiles, OWA and mobile — a symptom-to-root-cause decision tree with exact tests, so client issues resolve on first contact. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Diagnose and fix Outlook, OWA, and mobile mail connectivity fast

“Outlook won't connect” is one of the highest-volume messaging tickets — and without a method it's guesswork. This solution is a layered client-connectivity troubleshooting toolkit for Exchange Online / hybrid: Autodiscover flow, MAPI-over-HTTP / EWS / ActiveSync endpoints, authentication (modern auth, conditional access), profile and cached-mode issues, OWA, and mobile — a decision tree from symptom to root cause with the exact tests (Test-* cmdlets, Remote Connectivity Analyzer, message headers) — so client issues resolve on first contact.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the client-connectivity model: Autodiscover, protocol endpoints (MAPI/HTTP, EWS, ActiveSync, OWA), modern auth / conditional access, and the layered diagnostic method.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (EXO/hybrid, DNS/Autodiscover, admin + test accounts, EXO PowerShell / RCA access).
  • Diagnostic Playbook — a symptom→root-cause decision tree (can't set up profile, disconnects, auth loops, free/busy, OWA/mobile) with the exact tests and remediations at each node — each check named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Exchange Online PowerShell (EXO V3) / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (Autodiscover resolves, protocols connect, auth succeeds) plus Best Practices for reducing client-connectivity ticket volume.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

The highest-volume mail tickets resolved on first contact — Autodiscover, protocols, and auth diagnosed by a repeatable decision tree with exact tests — less guesswork, faster fixes, happier users.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • Get-ClientConnectivityAssessment.ps1 — Read-only per-user Outlook/Exchange client-connectivity assessment (protocol enablement +
    • Get-ClientConnectivityScope.ps1 — Read-only scope/health helper: assess client-connectivity across a set of users and bucket the
    • Set-MailboxProtocolAccess.ps1 — Re-enable (or disable) a client protocol on a mailbox - SAFE BY DEFAULT: dry-run report only
    • Test-AutodiscoverEndpoints.ps1 — Read-only test of the Autodiscover (Discovery) layer for a user/domain: DNS records, the
    • Test-ModernAuthConditionalAccess.ps1 — Read-only summary of the Authentication layer for a user: org modern-auth (OAuth), per-user

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
